bridgeQuestion: See the F508del mutation on the protein.
notes: Phase 9 P9.2.1 (docs/phase-9-generalisation.md section 11). HGNC:1884. The variant is the in-frame deletion F508del, named by its transcript-level HGVS c.1521_1523del, which the Ensembl variant recoder must confirm on the MANE Select transcript; every position, codon and residue in the records is read back from the responses. The ClinVar uid 7105 is the VCV000007105 record; the builder refuses the set unless the esearch by rsID returns it. Structure: the candidates named by rule 4 were checked in order on 2026-11-03 with scripts/data-preparation/check-structure-candidates.ts --uniprot P13569 --residue 508 --entries 6MSM,5UAK (report research/derived/structure-candidates-P13569-508.json). 6MSM (electron microscopy, 3.2 A) observes residue 508 on chain A as PHE, but its polymer entity is the E1371Q construct (_entity.pdbx_mutation "E1371Q"; the entity sequence differs from UniProt at position 1371), a difference no selected variant explains, which the builder refuses (T38). 5UAK (electron microscopy, 3.87 A; dephosphorylated, ATP-free human CFTR) observes residue 508 on chain A (label and auth 508, PHE) and its entity equals UniProt over the mapped segment 1 to 1480, so 5UAK is taken under structurePreference variant-residue-observed. The reference structure shows the position of the residue that F508del deletes, never the mutant protein.
